general.title: General Provisions
general.1_1: 1.1. This Privacy Policy (hereinafter - "Policy") defines the procedure for collection, storage, use, transfer and protection of personal data of users (hereinafter - "Users") on the website/in the application/in the company "Hooome;)" (hereinafter - "Operator").
general.1_2: 1.2. The Policy is developed in accordance with the Constitution of the Republic of Belarus, the Law of the Republic of Belarus dated May 7, 2021 No. 99-Z "On Personal Data Protection" (hereinafter - the Law), and other legislative acts of the Republic of Belarus.
general.1_3: 1.3. By using the Operator's website/services, the User expresses their full and unconditional consent to the terms of this Policy. If the User does not agree with the terms of the Policy, they must stop using the resource.
general.li1: Personal data - any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person.
general.li2: Processing of personal data - any action or set of actions performed with personal data, including collection, systematization, storage, modification, use, anonymization, blocking, distribution, provision, deletion.
general.li3: Personal data subject - a natural person to whom personal data relates (User).
general.li4: Operator - a legal or natural person who independently or jointly with other persons organizes and (or) carries out the processing of personal data.

dataComposition.title: Composition of Processed Personal Data
dataComposition.2_1: 2.1. The Operator may process the following User data provided voluntarily:
dataComposition.li4: Data automatically transmitted during website use: IP address, cookie data, browser information, device type, operating system, date and time of access, geolocation (if allowed).
dataComposition.2_2: 2.2. The Operator does not process special categories of personal data (regarding racial, national origin, health, etc.), as well as data related to criminal records, without the explicit consent of the User, unless provided by law.

processingPurposes.title: Purposes of Personal Data Processing
processingPurposes.3_1: 3.1. The Operator processes personal data for the following purposes:
processingPurposes.li1: User identification during registration and use of services;
processingPurposes.li4: Informing the User about new products, services, promotions (only with their consent);
processingPurposes.li6: Improving the quality of the website and services;
processingPurposes.li7: Fulfilling the requirements of the legislation of the Republic of Belarus.

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.4_1: 4.1. Processing of personal data is carried out on the following legal grounds:
legalBasis.li1: Consent of the personal data subject (provided by performing conclusive actions or checking the appropriate box);
legalBasis.li2: Conclusion and execution of a contract where the personal data subject is a party;
legalBasis.li3: Fulfillment of obligations imposed on the Operator by legislation (e.g., accounting, taxation).

processingProcedure.title: Processing Procedure and Terms. Data Storage.
processingProcedure.5_1: 5.1. Processing of personal data is carried out using automation tools and without such tools.
processingProcedure.5_2: 5.2. The Operator guarantees the confidentiality of personal data and takes all measures to protect them from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, or destruction.
processingProcedure.5_3: 5.3. The Operator has the right to transfer personal data to third parties only in the following cases:
processingProcedure.li1: The User has expressed consent to this;
processingProcedure.li2: Transfer is necessary for service provision (e.g., to a courier service for delivery);
processingProcedure.li3: Transfer is provided for by the legislation of the Republic of Belarus (e.g., at the request of authorized state bodies);
processingProcedure.li4: To involve payment systems and banks for payment processing.
processingProcedure.5_4: 5.4. Personal data is stored on the territory of the Republic of Belarus. Transfer of data abroad is carried out only to countries that provide an adequate level of protection, or with the consent of the subject.
processingProcedure.5_5: 5.5. The storage period of personal data is determined by the purposes of their processing. After achieving the purposes or withdrawal of consent, the data is subject to destruction or anonymization, unless otherwise provided by law (e.g., the storage period for accounting documents).

userRights.title: Rights of the Personal Data Subject (User)
userRights.6_1: The User, as a personal data subject, in accordance with the Law of the Republic of Belarus, has the right to:
userRights.li1: Receive information about the processing of their personal data;
userRights.li3: Clarify (modify) their personal data in case of incompleteness or inaccuracy;
userRights.li4: Withdraw consent to the processing of personal data;
userRights.li5: Request termination of processing and deletion of their personal data, except when processing is required by law;
userRights.li6: Appeal against the actions (inaction) of the Operator to the authorized body - the Operational and Analytical Center under the President of the Republic of Belarus, which is the body exercising state regulation in the field of personal data protection.

dataProtection.title: Personal Data Protection

contents.policyChanges: 7. Changes to the Cookie Usage Policy

whatIsCookie.title: What are cookies?
whatIsCookie.1_1: 1.1. Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device (computer, smartphone, tablet) when you visit websites. They are widely used to ensure the correct and efficient operation of the site, remembering your actions and preferences (such as login, language, font size and other display settings) over a certain period of time.
whatIsCookie.1_2: 1.2. In addition to cookies, similar technologies for collecting and storing information may be used on this site, such as web beacons (pixel tags), browser local storage (Local Storage), etc. Within this Policy, all such technologies are combined under the term 'cookie'.

cookiePurposes.title: Why do we use cookies?
cookiePurposes.2_1: We use cookies for the following purposes:
cookiePurposes.essential: Strictly necessary (Essential): These files are technically necessary for the basic operation of the site and ensuring its security. Without them, the site cannot function properly. They do not collect information that can be used for marketing or remember your actions on the internet.
cookiePurposes.functional: Functional (Preferences): Allow the site to remember choices and settings you have made to provide enhanced and personalized functionality.
cookiePurposes.analytics: Analytical/Performance (Analytics): Allow us to understand how visitors interact with the site (e.g., which pages they visit most often), collect anonymous statistics. This information helps us improve the site's operation, its structure and content.
cookiePurposes.marketing: Marketing/Targeting (Targeting): Used to track visitors across different sites. The goal is to show relevant and personalized advertising to a specific user, as well as measure the effectiveness of advertising campaigns. Such cookies may share information with other advertising partners.

cookieManagement.title: Managing cookies and your consent
cookieManagement.3_1: 3.1. Strictly necessary (essential) cookies are placed on your device automatically based on our legitimate interest in ensuring the technical functionality of the site. Your consent for their use is not required.
cookieManagement.3_2: 3.2. For placing all other categories of cookies (functional, analytical, marketing), we need your voluntary, informed and unambiguous consent.
cookieManagement.3_3: 3.3. How to give or withdraw consent:
cookieManagement.li1: On your first visit to the site, you will see a pop-up window (banner) requesting consent to use cookies. You can accept all cookies, reject all except necessary ones, or manually configure preferences by selecting categories.
cookieManagement.li2: You can change cookie settings or completely withdraw your consent at any time using the special cookie management panel available via the link at the bottom of the site or through your browser settings (see item 3.4).
cookieManagement.li3: Withdrawal of consent will not affect the legality of processing carried out prior to withdrawal.
cookieManagement.3_4: 3.4. How to manage cookies through browser settings:
cookieManagement.browsers: You can configure or disable the use of cookies directly in your web browser. Please note that disabling all cookies, including strictly necessary ones, may lead to incorrect operation of the site (e.g., inability to log into your personal account or place an order).
cookieManagement.browserList: Instructions for popular browsers: Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Safari, Microsoft Edge

thirdPartyCookie.title: Third-party cookies and services
thirdPartyCookie.4_1: 4.1. Third-party services may be used on our site (e.g., YouTube videos, Google Maps, social media buttons, analytics systems). These third-party providers may place their own cookies on your device. We do not control and are not responsible for the use of cookies by these third-party sites and services. Their use is governed by the privacy policies of the respective companies.
thirdPartyCookie.4_2: 4.2. We make reasonable efforts to indicate the third-party services used and provide links to their policies. However, their list may change. We recommend that you review the privacy policies of these companies.

cookieStorage.title: Cookie storage period
cookieStorage.5_1: 5.1. Different cookies are stored on your device for different periods:
cookieStorage.session: Session cookies – automatically deleted after closing the browser.
cookieStorage.persistent: Persistent cookies – remain on the device for a specified period (from several days to several years), unless you delete them manually.

userRights.title: Your rights
userRights.6_1: As a personal data subject, in accordance with the Law of the Republic of Belarus 'On Personal Data Protection', you have the right to access, clarify, withdraw consent and delete your data. For more information about your rights and the procedure for exercising them, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

policyChanges.title: Changes to the Cookie Usage Policy
policyChanges.7_1: 7.1. We may update this Policy from time to time to reflect changes in the technologies we use or legal requirements. The current version of the Policy will always be available on this page with the date of the last update.

0.title: How to register on the portal?
steps: Click the "Sign in" button in the top right corner of the page and go to the registration page
Fill in the required fields: Last name, First name, Patronymic; Email (will be used to sign in); Create a strong password
Confirm your email by following the link in the message that will arrive within 5 minutes

1.title: What information is required for registration?
1.paragraph: To successfully register you will need to provide:
required: Strong password (we recommend using a combination of letters, numbers and special characters)
1.optionalTitle: Additional information (can be filled in later):
1.securityNote: Data security: All your personal data is protected

2.title: How to sign in to your account?
2.paragraph: To sign in to your account you need to:
steps: Click the "Sign in" button in the top right corner of the site
Enter the email you used during registration
ifCannot: Check that the email and password are entered correctly (case sensitive)
Make sure Caps Lock is off
If you forgot your password — use the password recovery feature
If the email is not confirmed — check the "Spam" folder or request a new confirmation email

3.title: How to recover a forgotten password?
3.paragraph: If you forgot your account password, you can recover it in a few minutes:
steps: On the sign-in page click the "Forgot password?" link
Enter the email you used during registration
Check your email — you will receive a message with a link to reset your password
Follow the link from the email (valid for 24 hours)
Create and enter a new password
Confirm the new password by entering it again
3.ifNoMailTitle: If the email does not arrive:
ifNoMail: Make sure you enter the email you used during registration
If the email still does not arrive, repeat the procedure or contact support

4.title: How to change email or phone number in your account?
4.paragraph: You can change contact details in your account yourself:
changeEmailSteps: Enter the new email and your current password to confirm
A confirmation email will be sent to the new address
Follow the link in the email to complete the email change
4.changePhoneNote: To change your phone number repeat the steps from the previous section
4.importantNote: Important: After changing the email all notifications will be sent to the new address. The old email will no longer be active for signing in.

5.title: What to do if I did not receive the confirmation email?
5.paragraph: If the confirmation email does not arrive, perform the following actions:
searchSteps: Use mail search with queries: "Housing Service", "email confirmation", "account activation"
Make sure there is enough free space in your mailbox
resendSteps: Enter your email and password (if you have already registered)
If the email is not confirmed, the system will offer to resend the message
Wait up to 15 minutes and check your mail again
5.ifStillNoMailTitle: If the email still does not arrive:
ifStillNoMail: Check that the email entered during registration is correct
Try using a different email address
Contact support and provide the email you used during registration
Try registering on another day (temporary issues with mail services may occur)

0.title: How to contact the portal technical support?
0.paragraph: You can contact the technical support of the Housing and Utilities Service portal in several ways:
emailDetails: Specify the issue in the subject line
0.chat: Online chat on the website: Icon in the bottom right corner
specifyDetails: Description of the problem with the site section
Date and time of the issue
0.tip: Tip: Before contacting, check if your question is already answered in this FAQ section.

1.title: How to find contacts of your housing maintenance office/management company?
1.paragraph: You can find the contacts of your service organization in several ways:
steps: Log in to your personal account
systemShows: Name and details of the housing office
Phone numbers of dispatcher, emergency service, accounting
1.tip: If the data is outdated: Report it via the feedback form, and we will update the information.

2.title: How to file a complaint about the portal or employees?
2.paragraph: If you encounter problems with the portal or inappropriate behavior of employees, you can file a complaint:
formSteps: Select 'Complaint' as the type of request
2.mustSpecify: What must be specified in the complaint:
specifyDetails: Full name and contact details of the applicant
Date and time of the incident
termsDetails: Full investigation and response — up to 30 calendar days
In complex cases, the period may be extended
2.confidentiality: Confidentiality: All complaints are handled confidentially.

3.title: Where to turn after hours or in emergencies?
3.paragraph: In non-working hours and emergencies, use the following contacts:
3.dispatcher: City unified dispatcher service: 112 or 115 (from mobile)
dispatcherDetails: Transfer to the required service if necessary
3.supportNumber: Portal technical support number after hours:
autoAnswerDetails: In emergencies redirects to the responsible person’s mobile
chatBotDetails: Accepts requests for processing during working hours
3.tip: Important: When contacting emergency services, clearly state the address, floor, nature of the problem, and your contact details.

4.title: How to leave feedback about the portal or suggest improvements?
4.paragraph: Your feedback and suggestions help us improve the service. You can leave them in several ways:
waysDetails: Evaluation at the end of a support chat
Special form in your personal account: 'Settings' → 'Leave feedback'
acceptedDetails: Suggestions for integrations with other services

0.title: What to do if a pipe bursts in the apartment?
0.paragraph: If you discover a leak in the apartment water supply, act quickly and systematically:
stepsImmediate: Shut off the water: find the nearest cold or hot water valve
If you don't know where the valve is — shut off the main riser in the stairwell
Turn off the electricity in the affected room at the panel
Warn the downstairs neighbors about possible flooding
Collect water: use rags, buckets, basins
contacts: Dispatcher of the management company: number is on the bill
Insurance company: if you have apartment insurance
docs: Request that a ZHEU representative draw up an incident report
Obtain a copy of the report with signature and stamp
0.tip: Important: Do not attempt to repair main pipes yourself — it is dangerous and may worsen the situation.

1.title: What to do if the stairwell lights are out?
1.paragraph: If the stairwell lighting goes out, follow this algorithm:
checks: Only your stairwell? — problem with the stairwell power supply
Whole building without power? — outage at the building panel or district level
Only some bulbs? — burned-out bulbs need replacement
actions: Submit a request through the portal in the 'Emergency situations' section
Use a flashlight on your phone when moving through the dark stairwell
Warn neighbors, especially elderly people and those with small children
norms: Replacement of burned-out bulbs: up to 7 days
Electrical panel repair: up to 3 days
1.tip: Safety: Do not attempt to repair stairwell wiring yourself — it is life‑threatening and requires special permits.

2.title: What to do in case of a sewer blockage?
2.paragraph: A blockage can occur in your apartment or in the common riser:
2.headingDetect: How to determine the blockage location:
detect: Only in your apartment: water does not drain from sinks/bath
Common riser: water rises in the toilet, noise in pipes heard by neighbors
Basement or yard: unpleasant smell, puddles in the yard
2.headingFlat: Actions for a blockage inside the apartment:
flatActions: Try cleaning the traps under sinks
Use a plunger or chemical cleaners (carefully!)
2.headingCommon: Actions for a common riser blockage:
commonActions: Immediately report to the emergency ZHEU service
Warn upstairs neighbors not to use water
If flooding is imminent, turn off the electricity
Prepare rags and containers for water
payment: Blockage inside the apartment: paid by the apartment owner
Blockage in the common riser: paid by the management company
If tenants are at fault: costs are distributed among those responsible
2.tip: Prevention: Do not throw grease, hair, hygiene products, or food waste into the sewer.

3.title: What to do if heating is turned off in cold weather?
3.paragraph: Heating outages in winter require prompt action to prevent freezing:
measures: Check radiators in all rooms — the outage may be local
Ask neighbors — is the outage building-wide or only in your apartment
Turn on portable heaters to maintain minimum temperature
Slightly open taps so water does not freeze in pipes
inform: Unified heat supply organization: number on the information board
norms: Allowed temperature drop: no more than 8 consecutive hours
Maximum interruption during heating season: 24 hours
rights: Request a recalculation for days without heating
Receive compensation for using alternative heating sources
File a collective complaint in case of prolonged outage
3.tip: Important: If apartment temperature falls below +12°C you may request temporary housing at the expense of the responsible organization.

4.title: What to do if the elevator breaks down and you are stuck?
4.paragraph: If you are trapped in an elevator, stay calm and follow the instructions:
4.headingRules: Behavior rules in a stuck elevator:
rules: Do not panic — the elevator is securely held
Press the 'Call' button or call the dispatcher
Provide your address, stairwell number, approximate floor and number of people
Do not try to open the doors yourself — it is dangerous
Conserve phone battery for communication with rescuers
response: Release of people: no more than 1 hour
after: Request an incident report to be drawn up
Clarify the cause of the malfunction
File a claim for moral damages if applicable
4.tip: Prevention: Do not overload the elevator, do not jump in the cabin, do not hold the doors.

5.title: What to do if you find cracks in the building walls?
5.paragraph: Cracks in building structures may indicate serious problems. Assess the situation and follow the instructions:
danger: Non-dangerous (hairline): less than 1 mm, not growing
Dangerous: more than 5 mm, increasing, through-cracks
actions: Photograph cracks with a scale ruler
Install monitoring markers (paper strips with date)
Ask neighbors if they have similar problems
Submit a collective request via the portal or in writing
where: Management company / ZHEU — for initial inspection
State housing inspectorate — if the management company does not act
Construction expertise service — for professional assessment
Prosecutor's office — if there is a threat to life and health
5.tip: Warning: If cracks grow rapidly (more than 1 mm per month) immediately inform emergency services and evacuate the premises.

6.title: What to do in case of smoke or burning smell in the stairwell?
6.paragraph: Smoke or a burning smell in the stairwell are signs of a possible fire. Act quickly and safely:
stepsImmediate: Inform the dispatcher of the exact address, stairwell and floor where smoke is coming from
Alert neighbors, especially on upper floors
Open windows in the stairwell for ventilation if it is safe
Turn off electricity at the stairwell panel
evacuation: Do not use the elevator — use the stairs only
Help elderly neighbors and children evacuate
Breathe through a damp cloth if smoke is heavy
Move while crouching — there is less smoke near the floor
sources: Short circuit in the electrical panel
Combustion of trash in the garbage chute
prevention: Do not store flammable materials in the stairwell
Monitor the condition of electrical wiring
6.tip: Important: Even if the smoke has cleared, wait for the fire service to arrive to check the source of the smoke.
